description: No indeterminate form: the function is continuous at the limit point, evaluate by direct substitution.

exercises.technique: No indeterminate form: sqrt(3x^2-11) is continuous at x=3 and 3(3)^2-11=16≥0, so evaluate by direct substitution.
No indeterminate form: e^x is continuous and 2e^x never vanishes, so evaluate by direct substitution at x=0.
No indeterminate form: every term is a continuous exponential/polynomial product, so evaluate by direct substitution at x=0 (2·1-0·1+2·1+4).
No indeterminate form: sqrt(x^2-1) is continuous at x=1 (x^2-1=0≥0) and the whole expression is continuous there, so evaluate by direct substitution.
